title: SkillsMP Search
copilot_cli_intro: Use this workflow when GitHub Copilot CLI needs to discover community skills from SkillsMP before installation or adaptation.
copilot_rules: Use keyword search for exact terms such as tool names, formats, and platforms.
Use AI semantic search for goal-oriented requests when the user does not know exact skill names.
Rank results by fit, repository quality signals, stars, and recency.
Treat marketplace results as discovery only and inspect linked repositories before recommending adoption.
copilot_avoid: Treating a marketplace listing as proof of safety
Using vague searches such as `best skills` without narrowing intent
Recommending installation before reviewing the underlying repository
vscode_intro: Use SkillsMP when the task is to discover community skills that match a tool, workflow, or intent.
vscode_rules: Prefer keyword search for exact terms and AI search for intent-heavy prompts.
Summarize why each returned skill matches the user's request.
Treat SkillsMP as a discovery index, not a security guarantee.
Recommend repo review before installation or reuse.
instruction_rules: Use the SkillsMP workflow for requests to discover or compare community skills.
Choose keyword search for exact terms and AI search for intent-heavy requests.
Rank results by fit, stars, recency, and repository quality signals.
Treat marketplace listings as discovery, then inspect the repository before recommending installation.
prompt_intro: Use SkillsMP to find relevant community skills, then summarize the best candidates and call out review steps before adoption.
prompt_checklist: Choose keyword or AI search based on how specific the user's request is.
Use one concrete query at a time.
Summarize the top matching skills with name, repo, and fit.
Separate marketplace discoveries from your own recommendation.
Call out that the repository should be reviewed before installation.
